explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on tokens that mark a contrast, reversal, or boundary against the preceding narrative state: explicit negation (' not', " n't", ' never') and temporal turning-point markers (' on' in 'From then on', ' end' in 'In the end', ' onwards', ' ever' in 'more than ever'). It stays quiet on ordinary content words and on affirmative, continuing narration. Token identity explains 47% of activation variance and the peak token itself drives the activation, while the vocabulary lens is incoherent (logit and Jacobian promoted lists share nothing), so there is no lookahead signal.
